metadata.purpose: Universal schema for summarizing reasoning toggles by K-node—workflow-agnostic, row-oriented table. All parameters are enforced; K-node columns are dynamically populated at runtime from the active workflow.
metadata.usage: Each parameter is a ROW, active K-nodes are COLUMNS (dynamically injected from current workflow)

changelog.v3.0: Added 'description' field between k_node and temp for node purpose clarity
changelog.v3.1: Enforced specific tool names in rag_internal/rag_external; moved hybrid_cot_tot position
changelog.v3.2: Converted to row-oriented table format (parameters as rows, K-nodes as columns)
changelog.v3.3: Made schema workflow-agnostic; column headers and node_descriptions must be supplied dynamically by the workflow. No K-node is hardcoded in schema.
changelog.v3.4: Enforced max 4 columns per table (parameter + 3 K-nodes). Render as multiple tables as needed for all nodes.
changelog.v3.6: Added Archetype Strategy Matrix and bound K.1/K.2/K.3 to inherit strategic directives; populated strategic rows instead of '-'.
changelog.v3.7: Reordered row_definitions so rag_focus_strategy appears BEFORE rag_type; no other behavioral changes.
changelog.v3.8: Deprecated 'rag_internal'. Split into 'rag_user_files' (user-provided via manifest) and 'rag_system_tools' (platform-provided) for clarity and to support Just-in-Time file handling.

table_structure.column_headers: DYNAMIC: Populated at runtime with active K-node IDs from current workflow (e.g., [K.1, K.2, K.4, K.7, ...])
table_structure.column_chunking_note: No more than 3 columns per table: 1 parameter column + max 2 K-nodes. If workflow has more K-nodes, generate multiple tables sequentially to cover all K-nodes.

descriptions.description: Brief 3-4 word description of node purpose (must be supplied by current workflow for each K-node)
descriptions.rag_focus_strategy: Allocation of research focus between Company vs Person (e.g., WEIGHTED (80% Co / 20% Person))
descriptions.rag_type: Retrieval mode: OFF / Internal / External / Hybrid
descriptions.rag_user_files: User-provided knowledge sources (from file manifest) - MUST list specific file names.
descriptions.rag_system_tools: System-provided internal tools or data sources (not user-provided) - MUST list specific tool names.
descriptions.rag_external: External retrieval sources - MUST list specific tool names with call counts (min 2 calls): e.g. 'web_search (6), web_fetch (2)'
descriptions.rag_hops: Sequential query depth for multi-hop retrieval
descriptions.rag_recency_weight: Weight for source recency in reranking (0.0-1.0, complements authority + relevance)
descriptions.anchor_temporal_window_days: Maximum age in days for evidence to qualify as personalization anchor
descriptions.claim_verification_mode: Strictness of claim verification: strict (≥0.90) | balanced (≥0.80) | permissive (≥0.70)
descriptions.hybrid_cot_tot: Master toggle for hybrid reasoning architecture (ON/OFF)
descriptions.cot_min_paths: Number of parallel complete reasoning chains (Slide 1→7)
descriptions.tot_branches: Number of specialist branches at ambiguity points (0 = pure CoT)
descriptions.min_tot_depth: Minimum exploration depth for each ToT branch (0 = no ToT)
descriptions.self_consistency: Number of independent reasoning runs for cross-validation
descriptions.message_format_template: Narrative scaffold for generated outreach (e.g., ANALYST_LEVEL_PITCH, OPERATIONAL_PITCH, EXECUTIVE_CANDIDATE_PITCH, SKILL_TO_ROLE_MAPPING)

node_descriptions: DYNAMIC: Must be provided by the workflow at runtime. Each active K-node (e.g., 'K.1', 'K.2.5', etc.) must supply a 3–6 word node purpose label for the description row.

structure: | description | Classify Message Type | Subject Line | Generate Body |
table_example.chunking_example_note: If a workflow exposes more than 3 K-nodes, render additional tables, each with up to 3 K-nodes, until all nodes are covered. For example, K.1–K.3 in the first table, K.4–K.6 in the next, etc.

cell_population_rules.purpose: Enforce specificity and auditability for all parameters and nodes across all workflows.

rag_user_files.format: Comma-separated list of actual file names from the file_manifest

rag_system_tools.format: Comma-separated list of actual tool names

rag_external.format: Comma-separated list of tool names with call counts in parentheses

rag_type_derivation.OFF: rag_user_files, rag_system_tools, and rag_external are all empty or '-'
rag_type_derivation.Internal: (rag_user_files OR rag_system_tools is populated) AND (rag_external is empty/'-')
rag_type_derivation.External: (rag_external is populated) AND (rag_user_files AND rag_system_tools are empty/'-')
rag_type_derivation.Hybrid: (rag_user_files OR rag_system_tools is populated) AND (rag_external is populated)

validation.on_table_generation: BLOCK if rag_user_files, rag_system_tools, or rag_external contains forbidden values
validation.error_message: RAG rows must list specific tool/file names, not category labels

rendering_instructions.dynamic_k_nodes: At table rendering time, load the list of active K-nodes (e.g., K.1, K.2, K.2.5, etc.) from the current workflow context.
rendering_instructions.dynamic_descriptions: For each active K-node, require the workflow to supply a purpose label for the 'description' row (e.g., 'Classify Message Type', 'Competitive Position', etc.).
rendering_instructions.unused_cells: If a parameter is not used by a K-node, populate the cell with '-' for that K-node.
rendering_instructions.table_chunking: When rendering, generate tables with no more than 4 columns: the parameter column plus up to 3 K-nodes. If the workflow has more than 3 K-nodes, repeat the table structure as many times as needed, sequentially covering all K-nodes.
rendering_instructions.row_order: All tables must use the same parameter row order as defined in 'row_definitions.order'.
rendering_instructions.schema_extensibility: If a workflow introduces additional K-nodes, these are added as columns at runtime, with node_descriptions injected for each.
rendering_instructions.minimum_compliance: All parameter rows and all active K-nodes must be displayed in every run; no hardcoded K-node columns.
rendering_instructions.table_chunking_enforcement: Rendering logic MUST enforce that no table exceeds 4 columns (parameter + 3 K-nodes); this is non-negotiable for workflow consistency and readability.
